title: On Shining on half the table at once
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：shine　|　正文 359 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shine 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the lamp ① shone on half the table at once at once, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the lamp ② shines on half the table at once in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ shine on half the table at once at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ shone on half the table at once before — a line in the logbook for July 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Shining on half the table at once at once, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the lamp ever ⑥ shines through the broken pane all night in the rain before the July rains, nobody in the harbour would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ shine through the broken pane all night in the rain and never speak of it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a second lamp ⑧ shines through the broken pane all night at once every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the harbour said a word; ⑨ The lamp shone on half the table at once again in 2003, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To shine on half the table at once, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, the lamp shines on half the table at once in the rain again and the lamp must shine on half the table at once at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 照着（一般过去式 shone on half the table at once：1993 年那盏灯头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 照着（一般现在 shines on half the table at once：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 照着（不定式 to shine on half the table at once：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 照着（过去完成时 had shone on half the table at once：1987 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 照着（动名词 shining on half the table at once 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 照耀（shines through the broken pane all night：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真照耀整夜透过大路上的破窗照着）
G. v. 照耀（shine through the broken pane all night：let it 之后的原形，指随它去整夜透过大路上的破窗照着）
H. v. 照着（后段两处：后来的那盏灯照例 shines through the broken pane all night，而那盏灯在 2003 年又一次 shone on half the table at once）

answers.why: shine 意为“照着”，1993 年那盏灯二话不说地照着一下子照亮了半张桌子，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 shone。
shine 意为“照着”，自那以后那盏灯淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 shines。
shine 意为“照着”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯照着一下子照亮了半张桌子”，此处为不定式 to shine on half the table at once。
shine 意为“照着”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人照着过，故用过去完成时 had shone。
shine 意为“照着”，那盏灯说“照着一下子照亮了半张桌子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 shining on half the table at once 作主语。
shine 意为“照耀”，叔叔说的是“万一那盏灯真照耀整夜透过大路上的破窗照着”，if 从句里用一般现在 shines through the broken pane all night。
shine 意为“照耀”，老手们的规矩是“随它照耀整夜透过大路上的破窗照着”（let it shine through the broken pane all night），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
shine 意为“照着”，后来的那盏灯每个汛期都照例照耀整夜透过大路上的破窗照着，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 shines。
shine 意为“照着”，那盏灯在 2003 年在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地照着一下子照亮了半张桌子，用一般过去式 shone 叙述。
shine 意为“照着”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要照着一下子照亮了半张桌子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 shine 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the lamp shone on half the table at once at once, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the lamp shines on half the table at once in the rain whenever the harbour asks.
Shining on half the table at once at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the lamp ever shines through the broken pane all night in the rain before the July rains, nobody knows what to do next.
